Allen buys time and scrambles right for a 21-yard touchdown. Commentary says Houston's defenders ran with receivers and nobody accounted for Allen's legs.
On third and long, Stroud takes a deep drop and runs for a first down into Buffalo territory.
Runs for 12 yards and a first down on second-and-10.
Runs up the middle for an 18-yard touchdown. The captions garble the runner's name and place extra-point commentary before the run.
Moore's first catch as a Bill gains 18 yards into Houston territory.
Deep attempt to Moore is incomplete; Kamari Lassiter is penalized for 46-yard defensive pass interference, placing the ball at the 1. Officially no play.

plays.description: Montgomery gains five yards on an inside run.
Third-down pass intended for Hutchinson is incomplete, forcing a punt. A rookie defender is credited without a readable name.
Throwing from his own end zone, Allen finds Kincaid for a leaping 38-yard reception.
Moore catches a pass for a first down; the ending field position is truncated.

Noel is open over the middle and runs outside before being forced out at the Buffalo 12.

Gains seven yards through traffic but is tackled short of the 10-yard line, bringing up fourth down.
Allen throws against the grain while moving; Kincaid catches it for a first down.
Shakir catches a pass and tries to gain yards after the catch.
Makes a 34-yard field goal after a high snap is handled, extending Buffalo's lead to 27-21.
Lunges for a first down with inches needed; the captions identify the eventual tackler unclearly as 'Bedford.'
Stroud connects with Boutte for 21 yards.
Completion to Wayne gains 12 yards.
Montgomery catches a wide-open 7-yard touchdown. Commentary describes flow left with Montgomery coming underneath the formation to the right.

Makes a 58-yard field goal to give Houston a 31-30 lead.
Runner gains a first down, fumbles, and Buffalo recovers. Derek Stingley Jr. is mentioned, but his exact role is cut off. The same sequence repeats at 11:44.

plays.description: Short toss ends with the receiver stepping out of bounds with two minutes on the clock. Receiver and yardage are unclear.
Play-action completion to Kincaid gains 35 yards. This is the clear Kincaid reception matching the supplied late-game DB entry.
On third-and-11, Palmer catches the go-ahead 34-yard touchdown. Commentary says Palmer turns Lassiter around and Bullock arrives late.
Two-point conversion pass to Coleman is incomplete.
Schultz catches a pass and benefits from a missed tackle for an 18-yard gain.
Stroud finds an open receiver for a first down. Commentary calls it a Buffalo breakdown; the following field-position caption says first-and-goal at the nine.

plays.player: C.J. Stroud; Greg Rousseau; Terrel Bernard
plays.description: Rousseau sacks Stroud and rips the ball loose from his right arm. Bernard recovers, ending Houston's final threat.

offense_strengths: Kincaid produced matched receptions of 38, 40 and 35 yards, including a late play-action gain.
Allen generated touchdowns with a 21-yard scramble, a 1-yard sneak and deep passes to Moore and Palmer.
Moore supplied multiple first-down catches, drew a 46-yard interference penalty and scored a 43-yard touchdown.
defense_weaknesses: Houston produced middle-field gains of 35 yards to Noel, 21 to Boutte and 20 to Hutchinson.
Benford's outside leverage without middle safety help left Collins available for the skinny-post touchdown.
Montgomery scored twice rushing and was wide open on his receiving touchdown after releasing opposite the play's flow.
The final Houston drive included a missed tackle on Schultz's 18-yard catch and another explicitly described coverage breakdown.

offense_strengths: Montgomery scored on 1-yard and 18-yard runs and a 7-yard reception.
Collins contributed an end-around first down, a 25-yard double-move reception and a 12-yard skinny-post touchdown.
Stroud distributed first-down completions among Collins, Noel, Boutte, Hutchinson, Wayne and Schultz, and converted third-and-long with his legs.
defense_weaknesses: Commentary identified no defender accounting for Allen's legs during his 21-yard touchdown against man coverage.
Blankenship's failed interception gamble opened Moore's 43-yard touchdown.
Lassiter committed the interference penalty setting up Allen's sneak and was turned around on Palmer's winning touchdown, with Bullock late to help.
Kincaid gained 113 yards across the three matched explosive receptions.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were available. The supplied DB is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not establish that a play was absent from the full game record. Field-goal yards are kick distances, interference yards are penalty yards, and sack yards use the DB narrative rather than its 0.0 turnover classification. The repeated fumble sequence at 11:44 is counted once. The late short toss and Kincaid play-action completion are listed separately as captioned, although the editing and two-minute references leave their exact chronology uncertain. The first-and-goal-at-nine caption conflicts with the supplied final sack location. Kickoffs and the Benford interference penalty are not listed because the captions do not identify those plays.
